title: Advance Liability Notice Forms Assigned to the Wound Care Supply Program Tiers
content:
# Advance liability notice forms — Wound Care Supply Program

Each tier of the Wound Care Supply Program names the advance notice of financial liability that a customer must sign before an item or quantity expected to be denied can be billed to them.

| Tier | Notice of financial liability |
|---|---|
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | not applicable |
| Wound Care Commercial HMO Program | plan member waiver |
| Wound Care Commercial PPO Program | plan member waiver |
| Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program | organization determination required |
| Wound Care Original Medicare Program | Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (form CMS-R-131) |
| Wound Care Medicaid Program | Medicaid non-covered agreement |

## Notes

- The two commercial tiers use the same form, the plan member waiver.
- The Wound Care Self-Pay Program has no notice, shown as not applicable.
- The entry for the Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program is not a customer form but the plan's organization determination.
